Hi Alice / Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the demo with us this morning — great discussion and some helpful callouts about latency sensitivity for your auto-summarization pipeline. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of deployment fit (based on today's call)
- Primary need: integrate a low-latency summarization endpoint into an existing ingestion pipeline; expected pilot traffic ~50–150 requests/minute with median prompt length ~600 tokens.
- Data residency: US-only for pilot; no additional on-prem requirement yet.
- Security: you'll send partial PII in prompts; you asked for SOC2 evidence and an export of retention/audit settings.

Our recommendation for pilot: Hosted API (fastest path)
- Why: fastest time-to-value (no infra or VPC setup), immediate access to sandbox endpoints, built-in prefix/KV cache and burst smoothing.
- Limits: we can provision a sandbox endpoint scoped to your account with a rate cap we control. For pilot we propose 60 requests/minute by default with 20 concurrent tokenized inference slots; we can raise this after smoke tests.

Quickstart plan / action items (owner in parentheses)
1) Sandbox provisioning (Redwood): create a token-scoped sandbox endpoint + demo credentials, rate cap set to 60 rpm / 20 concurrent (Rishi) — ETA 24 hours.
2) Provide sample security snapshot + SOC2 artifacts (Redwood): see attached security_snapshot.xlsx and SOC2 excerpt in SOW (Monica).
3) Traffic profile & test prompts (BlueNova): share 10 representative prompts and a short traffic timeline so we can match sequence-length distribution (Alice).
4) Short smoke test call after sandbox verification (15–20m) to validate latency and KV caching behavior (All).

Notes on Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private
- Hosted: recommended for pilot. Minimal ops, quick sandbox, full telemetry in Console. If you later need guaranteed throughput or co-located GPUs we can propose Dedicated reserved pools for month-to-month committed throughput.
- Dedicated: good when you need predictable throughput at scale and strict tenant isolation; usually a later stage after pilot.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): only recommended if procurement/regulatory requires customer-managed network or HSM key control; longer lead time.

Attachments: Blueno va_Quickstart_SOW.pdf (SOW excerpt with SOC2 ref), security_snapshot.xlsx (summary of retention and logs).

Next steps: Alice, can you share the 10 sample prompts and confirm the pilot start week (preferably May 20)? I'll spin up the sandbox and share credentials + the HubSpot ticket link.

Thanks — looking forward to the test.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
